title: openOODA MCP Server
content:
## What it is

The Model Context Protocol server for openOODA. Exposes 23 typed tools that AI agents (Claude, Cursor, custom) can call to read code, run tests, inspect capability graphs, and audit.

Invoked via `ooda mcp` (or your MCP client hosts the server directly).

## Install

The MCP server ships as part of the `ooda` toolchain. Once `ooda` is on PATH, you have `ooda mcp`.

## Surface

23 tools, organized in 5 tiers:

| Tier | Count | Examples |
|------|-------|----------|
| 0 — Core | 5 | `get_capability_graph`, `get_orientation`, `read_board`, `refresh_dynamic_graph`, `get_audit_log` |
| 1 — Token economy | 5 | `get_board_index`, `summarize_board`, `compress_orient`, `get_context_budget`, `estimate_chars` |
| 2 — OODA state | 4 | `get_ooda_phase`, `get_decision_journal`, `get_redteam_realtime`, `get_session_diagnostics` |
| 3 — Format | 2 | `get_format_constraints`, `validate_codex_format` |
| 4 — Workspace + audit | 7 | `get_northstar`, `get_security_threat_model`, `get_redteam_methodology`, `get_workflow_protocol`, `get_em_swarm`, `get_milestone_status`, `audit_compact` |
